input.query: SELECT shipment_id, order_id, carrier, shipped_ts, delivered_ts FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts LIKE '2025-04%' OR shipped_ts LIKE '2025-05%' OR shipped_ts LIKE '2025-06%' LIMIT 20

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_total, COUNT(delivered_ts) AS n_delivered, ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_days, MIN(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)) AS min_days, MAX(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)) AS max_days, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts < shipped_ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_cnt FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-07-01'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dup_orders, SUM(cnt) AS rows_in_dup FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

final_answer.basis: 語意層無對應定義，依 shipments 資料表計算：以 shipped_ts 落在 2025-04-01 至 2025-06-30 的出貨為範圍，配送天數為 delivered_ts 與 shipped_ts 的時間差（天）。所有物流商合計，平均只納入已送達的 9,947 筆（總出貨 11,128 筆）。檢查無重複訂單、無送達早於出貨的異常值，最短 0.63 天、最長 7.08 天。
